game: Junji Ito Maniac: An Infinite Gaol

achievements.name: Who Am I?
achievements.description: Start a new game.

achievements.name: Code of Chivalry
achievements.description: Meet with the mysterious girl in the master bedroom.

achievements.name: Companion...or Killer?
achievements.description: With Tomie, find Rin acting suspiciously in the garden.

achievements.name: The Truth
achievements.description: Enter the final room.

achievements.name: Guardian of Heads
achievements.description: Successfully escape from the balloon head and get back in the mansion.

achievements.name: Alchemy Master
achievements.description: In the darkroom, prepare the holy water used to destroy the black magic.

achievements.name: The Tunnel
achievements.description: Leave the mansion from the main door in the foyer.

achievements.name: Into the Abyss
achievements.description: Enter the basement from the gold doors and uncover the truth.

achievements.name: Maniac
achievements.description: Enter the secret room from the silver doors and uncover the truth.

achievements.name: Professional Poop Scooper
achievements.description: Don't miss a single chance to feed the cat. Meow.

achievements.name: I'm a Collector!
achievements.description: Complete the Collection.

achievements.name: Hobby Hunter
achievements.description: Set a bear trap.

achievements.name: Mysterious Mansion
achievements.description: Use an environment trap.

achievements.name: Destroyer of Statues
achievements.description: Use a bear trap to destroy a statue.

achievements.name: Assassin
achievements.description: Use an environment trap to destroy a statue.

achievements.name: Professional Hunter
achievements.description: Set 30 bear traps.

achievements.name: Disrespectful Guest
achievements.description: Use 30 environment traps.

achievements.name: Hide and Seek
achievements.description: Hide in a closet.

achievements.name: Shattered and Smashed
achievements.description: Destroy 20 statues.

achievements.name: Roly Poly
achievements.description: Clear any rolling ball maze in 20 seconds or less.

achievements.name: Don't Move!
achievements.description: Catch the balloon head in a bear trap or have it get tangled in the trellis.

achievements.name: Bold Adventurer
achievements.description: Leave the safe room.

achievements.name: Charon's Guest
achievements.description: Die and return to the safe room 10 times.

achievements.name: Comfort Zone
achievements.description: Stay in the safe room for a total of 20 minutes.

achievements.name: You Can't See Me
achievements.description: Stay in closets for a total of 10 minutes.

achievements.name: Extreme Challenge
achievements.description: Use less than 3 bear traps to kill enemies and reach any ending.

achievements.name: Visitor Etiquette
achievements.description: Use less than 3 environment traps to kill enemies and reach any ending.

achievements.name: Die-Hard Fan
achievements.description: Complete all achievements.
